RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Wednesday,  the October 22, 2008/Asvina 30, 1930 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Commerce and Industry; Defence; Earth Sciences; Home Affairs;
Information and Broadcasting; Labour and Employment; Rural Development;
Science and Technology; Textiles)
Total number of questions — 20
21
Reconstitution of zonal  nodal
agencies for ITIs
†*61. SHRI BALA V ANT ALIAS
BAL APTE:
SHRI SHREEGOPAL VYAS:
 Will the Minister of LABOUR AND
EMPLOYMENT be pleased to state:
(a)  whether Government is considering
to reconstitute zonal nodal agencies for
affiliation of Industrial Training Institutes
(ITIs) to the National Council for V ocational
Training (NCVT);
(b)  following carving out of  new States,
whether Government  proposes to
constitute new zonal nodal agencies for
Uttarakhand, Chhattisgarh and Jharkhand;
and
(c)  the number of proposals for setting
up of new ITIs from States received by
zonal nodal agencies in the years 2007-08
and 2008-09, along with the number and
details of new institutes set up
thereupon?
Arjun Tank Project
*62. SHRIMATI SYEDA ANW ARA
TAIMUR:
SHRI VIJAY JAW AHARLAL
DARDA:
 Will the Minister of DEFENCE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that in spite of 36
years spent in  Arjun Tank's design and
development, in December, 2007 it failed
the winter trials;
(b)  if so, whether the mandatory
procedure of comparative trials with
Russian tanks has been done, which is very
crucial before the induction of Arjun Tank
into Army;
(c)  the perception of defence experts,
who normally look ahead for 20 years while
inducting Main Battle Tanks, about Arjun
Tank which failed the winter trials; and
(d)  the fate of Arjun Tank Project of
the Defence Research and Development
Organisation (DRDO) now?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

22
Repealing of JPM Act, 1987
*63. SHRI NATUJI HALAJI
THAKOR:
SHRI VIJAYKUMAR RUPANI:
 Will the Minister of TEXTILES be
pleased to state:
(a)  whether Government is considering
repealing the Jute Packaging Materials
(Compulsory Use in Packing Commodities)
Act, 1987 in view of the fact that 21 years
have passed since the  enactment of JPM
Act, 1987 and during this period, jute
industry has grown sufficiently;
(b)  whether it is a fact that the Gujarat
High Court on 20 November, 2006 directed
Government to publish the fresh
Notification for dilution of 100 per cent
jute monopoly; and
(c)  if so, the action taken by
Government on the orders of the Gujarat
High Court to repeal the JPM Act, 1987
for dilution of 100 per cent jute packing for
foodgrains and sugar?
Attack against fishermen by
Sri Lankan Navy
*64. SHRI A. ELAV ARASAN: Will the
Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be pleased
to state:
(a)  whether Government  is aware that
a number of attacks have been made against
Tamil Nadu fishermen by the Sri Lankan
Navy;
(b)  if so, whether Government has taken
any action in this regard;
(c)  whether Government proposes to
introduce any ID card scheme to avoid such
attacks in future;
(d)  if so, the details thereof; and
( e) if not, the reasons therefor?
Tightening the existing laws for
fighting terrorism
*65. PROF. ALKA BALRAM
KSHATRIYA:
SHRIMATI SHOBHANA
BHARTIA:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS
be pleased to state:
(a)  whether in view  of terrorist strikes
in various parts of the country,
Government has decided to have close
coordination with States across the country
to tighten the existing laws;
(b)  if so, the details thereof;
(c)  whether Government has decided
to extend special assistance to States to
strengthen their machinery, system and
process; and
(d)  if so, the details thereof?
New law to curb terrorism
*66. SHRI  SU. THIRUNA VUK-
KARASAR: Will the Minister of HOME
AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a)  in how many places in India, bomb
blasts have taken place and how many
people have died in 2006-07 and 2007-08;
and
(b)  whether Government is going to
bring any new law to curb terrorism?
Establishing Central Agency to
monitor law and order
*67. SHRI SHANTARAM LAXMAN
NAIK: Will the Minister of HOME
AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a)  whether Government proposes to
establish a Central Agency to monitor and
supervise law and order in the country;

23
(b)  if so, whether any formal decision
has been taken in this regard;
(c)  whether any formal or informal
consultation with the State Governments
has been undertaken; and
(d)  if so, the details thereof?
Security master plan for NCT of
Delhi during Commonwealth Games
*68.SHRI DHARAM PAL
SABHARWAL: Will the Minister of
HOME AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a)  whether Delhi Police is preparing a
security master plan for NCT of Delhi in
view  of the forthcoming Commonwealth
Games;
(b)  if so, the details in this regard;
(c)  whether Delhi Police will also look
into the aspect of large scale Bangladeshi
and Nepalese entering the city illegally
every year; and
(d)  if so, the details in this regard?
Handloom cluster manufacturing
Banarasi Sarees
†*69. DR. MURLI MANOHAR
JOSHI:
SHRI SHIVANAND TIWARI:
Will the Minister of TEXTILES be
pleased to state:
(a)  whether it is a fact that the trade of
Banarasi sarees is important not only in
the  country but also in the international
market and lakhs of weavers are earning
livelihood by means of it in the country;
(b)  if so, Government's reaction thereto;
(c)  whether it is also a fact that there
are total twenty handloom clusters set up
at present in the country, out of which
Banarasi sarees are manufactured in only
one cluster; and
(d)  if so, the details thereof alongwith
the total number of production units in this
one cluster?
Joint military operations with USA
*70. SHRI RAJEEV SHUKLA:
DR. T. SUBBARAMI REDDY:
 Will the Minister of  DEFENCE be
pleased to state:
(a)  whether it is a fact that experts and
Army Chiefs of India and USA have
suggested that both the countries should
prepare for joint military operations;
(b)  if so, whether both the countries
have agreed to have joint military operations
in future;
(c)  whether India is at present having
joint military operations with other
countries also;
(d)  if so, whether any final decision in
this regard has been taken; and
( e)  if so, the details thereof and to
what extent it has been successful?
Comparative study on the functioning
of SEZs in India and China
 †*71. SHRI RAJ MOHINDER
SINGH MAJITHA:
SHRI RAM JETHMALANI:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a)  whether it is a fact that Special
Economic Zones on the lines of China have
been set up in the country;
(b) whether Government has
undertaken any comparative study on the
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

24
functioning of Special Economic Zones set
up in China and India;
(c)  if so, the details of the  study
conducted;
(d)  if not, the reasons therefor; and
(e)  whether such comparative study
would be conducted in future?
Increasing incidents of terrorism
†*72. SHRI  BRIJ BHUSHAN
TIWARI: Will the Minister of HOME
AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) whether increasing incidents of
terrorism have come to the notice of
Government;
(b)  if so, the reasons therefor;
(c)  whether it is a fact that there is
shortage of police force in States; and
(d)  if so, the State-wise details thereof
and total number of existing vacancies?
Demand for creation of new States
*73. SHRI  V . HANUMANTHA RAO:
DR. T. SUBBARAMI REDDY:
 Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS
be pleased to state:
(a)  whether his Ministry has been
flooded with demands for the creation of
atleast fifteen new States;
(b) whether it has received
recommendations from various sources for
the creation of several new States such as
Bhojpur in East Uttar Pradesh, Saurashtra
in Gujarat and also out of Bihar, Karnataka,
West Bengal;
(c)  if so, the total demands of new
States at present and whether Government
has considered these requests; and
(d)  the steps being taken in this regard?
Crimes against women
*74. DR. GYAN PRAKASH
PILANIA:
SHRI LALIT KISHORE
CHATURVEDI:
 Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS
be pleased to state:
(a)  the total number of FIRs registered
for atrocities against women, during the last
three years,  their disposal, decrease/
increase in percentage, incidence per ten
lakhs, State-wise, crime-wise and year-
wise;
(b)  how many cases occur every day
and in how many minutes/hours, one case
does occur on an average, in each category
of above crimes; and
(c)  the first three States/Metros in the
country, having worst scenario of atrocities
against women on the basis of total high
incidence of crime, poor challan percentage,
poor conviction percentage, year-wise high
percentage increase of crime, total high
incidence per ten lakh population?
Additional funds to Orissa to control
left-wing extremism
*75. SHRI  B.J. PANDA: Will the
Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be pleased
to state:
(a)  whether the Orissa Government has
asked for additional funds to strengthen its
security system to control left-wing
extremism;
(b) whether Government is aware that
22 out of the 30 districts in this State are
affected by naxal menace; and
(c)  if so, the action plan of the Centre
to help the State administration to
consolidate and expand its security network
in the Maoist areas of operation?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

25
Demonstration against allotment of
land to Amarnath Shrine Board
†*76. SHRI PRABHA T JHA: Will the
Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be pleased
to state:
(a)  whether demonstrations were held
in Kashmir to protest against the land being
given to Amarnath Shrine Board by Jammu
and Kashmir Government;
(b)  whether demonstrations were also
held all over the country against the taking
back of land from the Shrine Board;
(c)  if so, locations where incidents of
firing and lathi charge by police took place
and the number of  persons who died or
were injured in the same;
(d)  whether Government is considering
to declare the land to be given to Amarnath
Shrine Board as national land; and
(e)  if so, the details of memoranda
received by Government in this regard and
the action taken thereon?
Killing of Swami Laxamananand in
Kandhmal, Orissa
†*77.  SHRI RUDRA NARAYAN
PANY: Will the Minister of HOME
AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a)  whether Government is aware that
Swami Laxamananand Saraswati of
Kandhmal district in Orissa, had been
gruesomely murdered in the night of
Janmashtami;
(b)  if so,  information available with
Government on the cause of incident;
(c)  whether murderers have been caught
so far;
(d)  if not, advice and help being
provided by Centre to the State in this
regard;
(e)  whether the murder has triggered a
lot of tension; and
(f) if so, the measures taken or proposed
to be taken by Government to pacify and
end this tension?
Concern of Amnesty International
over human rights scenario
*78.  SHRI  N.K. SINGH: Will the
Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be pleased
to state:
(a)  whether  it is a fact that once again
Amnesty International has expressed its
concern on suppression of human rights in
India, citing instances in Nandigram, missing
persons  in J & K, rehabilitation of adivasis
in Dantewada in Chhattisgarh and non-
abolition of capital punishment;
(b)  if so,  the details in this regard; and
(c) the steps Government is
contemplating to address these issues?
Increase in monthly allowances to
Gallantry Awardees
†*79.  SHRI JAI PARKASH
AGGARW AL: Will the Minister of
DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a)  whether during the last three years,
requests have been received by Government
from various organisations with regard to
increasing monthly allowances to gallantry
award winners and sanctioning class-wise
pension and dearness allowance to Param
Vir Chakra, Ashoka Chakra, Maha Vir
Chakra, Kirti Chakra, Vir Chakra and
Shaurya Chakra award winners in
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

26
accordance with pension and dearness
allowance being given to freedom fighters;
(b)  if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the action taken/to be taken by
Government in this regard?
Major commodities exported
*80. DR. K. MALAISAMY: Will the
Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a)  the major commodities exported
abroad and the foreign exchange earned
during the last three years;
NEW DELHI; V . K. AGNIHOTRI,
The 16th October, 2008 Secretary-General.
Asvina 24, 1930 (Saka)
(b)  the major bottlenecks faced by
Indian exporters and how they are
got over;
(c)  the potential areas of export yet to
be exploited by Indian traders;
(d)  the grievance redressal mechanism
available to Indian exporters;
(e)  whether it has been effective; and
(f) the cases of harassment of exporters
at the hands of Government officers of
export zones?
